name: ZCA_SRT_REPORT_DEF
description: A transaction table to store the metadata of reports created by the user based on a specific report type.

columns.name: REPORT_ID
columns.description: Primary key of this table. This is a system generated unique identifier value.

columns.name: REPORT_NUMBER
columns.description: System generated unique public identifier column. This column is the alternate key.

columns.name: REPORT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the report entered by the user.

columns.name: REPORT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referring to column ZCA_SRT_REPORT_TYPES.REPORT_TYPE_ID

columns.name: REPORT_METADATA
columns.description: Stores the details of the report metadata like column, filter, group by that is configured by the user.

columns.name: REPORT_LSQL
columns.description: BI Logical SQL generated based on the report metadata.

columns.name: REPORT_DESC
columns.description: Description of the report entered by the user.

columns.name: OWNER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier of the report owner.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VISUALIZATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: This is the visualization type selected for ERT visualization. The values are based on lookup 'ORA_BI_CHART_TYPE'.
